top_offers.title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
top_offers.why: First engineering hire at a YC S26 startup building an agentic OS for e-commerce logistics is exactly the build-from-zero founding scope Magino had at Alaya, this time with an LLM-driven workflow layer that plays to his AI-augmented engineering focus. Stockholm hybrid means relocation, which is the main drag on fit given his Geneva preference, but the equity upside and end-to-end ownership are a strong match for a cofounder profile.

top_offers.title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
top_offers.why: Bootstrapped and already profitable, Orbit runs spec-driven agentic development on a TypeScript/AWS/React stack that lines up almost exactly with Magino's core toolkit and his current AI-augmented engineering practice. Remote-EU keeps it timezone-friendly from Geneva, though the title reads more IC-feature-level than the platform/founding scope he's prioritizing.

top_offers.title: Database Platform Engineer
top_offers.why: A Geneva-based seat at Proton, VC-free and profitable, is about as strong a location and company-culture match as it gets, and the mission (privacy infrastructure at scale) echoes the impact-driven bar he's held to since Alaya. Scored down because the scope reads as focused database/infra ownership rather than the Staff+/platform-wide mandate he's targeting, and there's no AI/LLM angle in the posting.
